item.title: Vero Beach parents sue city over infant son's remains allegedly disturbed, reburied without consent
item.description: Two Vero Beach parents have filed an amended lawsuit against the City of Vero Beach, alleging their infant son's remains were accidentally disturbed during maintenance at Crestlawn Cemetery and then reinterred without their knowledge or consent.

item.title: Decomposed body found near US-1 in Sebastian; second body found in area this week
item.description: A heavily decomposed body was discovered in shrubbery along the shoreline near 14510 US Highway 1 in Sebastian Wednesday afternoon, marking the second body found in the area this week.

item.title: Jensen Beach Orangetheory Fitness holds fundraiser workout for family of 5-year-old killed in bike accident
item.description: A Jensen Beach Orangetheory Fitness is rallying its community to support the family of 5-year-old Garrett Leonard, who was killed in an accident at a motocross park in Miami.

item.title: Women's Professional Baseball League unveils team names and logos ahead of August debut
item.description: The Women's Professional Baseball League announced the nicknames and logos for its four teams on Wednesday, with the inaugural season set to begin August 1 in Springfield, Illinois.

item.title: Messi scores eighth World Cup goal as Argentina rallies from two down to beat Egypt 3-2
item.description: Lionel Messi scored his eighth goal of the tournament and Argentina completed a comeback from 2-0 down with 11 minutes remaining to defeat Egypt 3-2 on Tuesday.

item.title: United States loses 4-1 to Belgium in World Cup round of 16
item.description: The United States was eliminated from the World Cup on Monday night when Belgium won 4-1 at Lumen Field in Seattle, ending American hopes for a deep run at the home tournament.

item.title: United States-Belgium World Cup match draws record 30 million viewers on Fox
item.description: Monday's United States-Belgium World Cup match became the most-watched soccer telecast in U.S. history with more than 30 million viewers, Fox Sports reported.

item.title: IOC ends neutral status vetting for Russian athletes ahead of 2028 Los Angeles Olympics
item.description: The International Olympic Committee advised Olympic sports bodies on Tuesday to end the three-year program vetting Russians for neutral status ahead of qualifying events for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

item.description:

item.title: Former Florida gubernatorial candidate Andrew Gillum arrested on drug possession charges in Alabama
item.description: The ex-Tallahassee mayor and 2018 Democratic candidate for governor was arrested on marijuana and methamphetamine possession charges after a traffic stop.

item.description: St. Lucie County residents and visitors will have the chance to learn life-saving skills this summer through free rip current safety demonstrations at local public pools.

item.title: Dale Mincey identified as suspect in fatal Fort Pierce shooting of 66-year-old man
item.description: The St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office has identified Dale Mincey as the suspect connected to a shooting that killed 66-year-old Andre Leonard Barnes in Fort Pierce.

item.title: Fort Pierce community remembers art teacher Andre Barnes as father figure after fatal shooting
item.description: Former students and community members are remembering Fort Pierce art teacher Andre Barnes, who was killed Tuesday in a shooting on Essex Drive.

item.title: St. Lucie County land rezoning vote scheduled for August on 85-acre development project
item.description: County commissioners are expected to vote in August on rezoning 85 acres off Indrio Road and Russakis Road from agricultural to planned retail workplace.

item.title: St. Lucie County schedules three rip current demonstrations at Lakewood, Boatwright, and Ravenswood pools
item.description: Three free rip current safety demonstrations are scheduled at St. Lucie County public pools this summer using a new simulation machine.
